Vivek —

Thanks for the invoice and the forms. A couple of points from our side: 

1) VAT treatment: ProspectCo is registered in Italy and typically uses reverse charge for SaaS, but our tax team requires your vendor VAT certificate and confirmation that Redwood will accept reverse charge (i.e., zero-rated invoice). Can you send your VAT registration extract or confirm the billing VAT number to include on the invoice?

2) Payment method: We prefer SEPA where possible. For very large amounts we sometimes need a SWIFT/wire — what banking details should we use if SEPA isn’t available? Make sure the wire instructions include the intermediary bank details; our treasury needs them.

3) PO: We will generate a PO but need the invoice to show the correct vendor VAT number and the client billing address to match our procurement records.

If you can provide the VAT extract and the completed wire form, we can move to PO issuance today and pay by end of week.

Regards,
Marco Rossi
Head of Finance (Acting CFO)
ProspectCo
